mapper.select: SELECT id, username, email, password_hash AS passwordHash FROM users WHERE email = #{email}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (username, email, password_hash) VALUES (#{username}, #{email}, #{passwordHash})
mapper.select: SELECT id, username, email, password_hash AS passwordHash FROM users WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, user_id AS userId, subtotal, shipping_fee AS shippingFee, ordered_at AS orderedAt FROM orders WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY ordered_at DESC

SELECT p.region_id AS regionId, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS count FROM orders o JOIN order_details od ON o.id = od.order_id JOIN products p ON od.product_id = p.id WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY p.region_id

SELECT od.id, od.order_id AS orderId, od.product_id AS productId, od.quantity, od.price, p.product_name AS name FROM order_details od JOIN products p ON od.product_id = p.id WHERE od.order_id = #{orderId}
